name: Banner
description: A banner shows your affiliation to a group, a house, or faction, and creates a sense of unity. While carrying one, you generate 1 Bonus Momentum for all Authority Combat Tasks.

name: Healing Potion
description: As a Minor Action, you can drink a Healing Potion and immediately restore HP equal to one health bar, and the Healing Potion is removed from your inventory. You may administer a potion to an adjacent ally as a Major Action.

name: Tome
description: Tomes are magic books or scrolls that increase the number of spells a spellcaster can use. As long as you already have spell slots, each tome you have in your inventory grants 2 additional spell slots.

name: Spell Implement
description: A spell implement (e.g. an arcane orb, or a holy staff) is necessary to cast spells effectively. (See Chapter Eight: Magick)
